MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot with a clock felt useful because voice control could complement my Fire TV devices, while the clock adds a practical reason to choose it.",
    "The Ring doorbell felt like a natural extension of my security-camera interest because it adds front-door visibility and visitor alerts."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV sticks do not meet a new need: I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television, and a decorative remote cover does not change that.",
    "The lighting bundle, tablet, and sport earbuds do not address what I currently want from home viewing and security equipment.",
    "The Blink Mini cameras fit my monitoring interests, but buying three more feels premature while I am still putting my recently purchased Blink XT2 to use."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Interest in a device seems to have been treated as a reason to buy more versions of it, although I usually need a distinct benefit to make another purchase."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a useful next purchase should add something my existing viewing or security setup does not provide.",
    "Closely related options compete for the same need. I would choose the Dot with a clock rather than buy several speakers.",
    "My recent camera purchase makes additional cameras less urgent, even though home monitoring remains relevant to me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home viewing and security, but confused useful additions with redundant devices and loosely related purchases."
}
